note: Folded engine. validateM1(state) returns { complete, stoppedAtQ1, firedRules, additionalFlags, conditionCount, timestamp }; form-app.js submitForm() assigns that result directly, so the flags are already inside it (detectAdditionalFlags is called by the validator, not by the UI) and no flagsHint is needed. The wall-clock timestamp key is stripped by bin/test-personas. This is a problem-oriented validator: a rule in m1Rules FIRES when something is wrong (missing or inconsistent), firedRules is stable-sorted urgent > high > medium > low after evaluation in rule order, and complete is true only when NO rule of category 'completeness' fired - so the low-priority 'recommended' contact-number rule M1-PD-005 still makes complete false. Quirks verified: stoppedAtQ1 (Q1 === 'no') skips only rules whose id starts with M1-Q2 / M1-Q3; the Part B GP rules gate themselves on Q1 === 'yes' and the personal-details and authorisation rules always run; conditionCount counts every Q2 'yes' regardless of Q1, so a stale Q2 answer on a Q1 = No form is still counted even though every mental-health flag requires q1 === 'yes'; flag ids do not match their priorities - FLAG-MH-HIGH-003 (eating disorder) is priority 'medium' and FLAG-AUTH-LOW-001 (declaration not confirmed) is priority 'high'; bipolar + personality disorder together raise only FLAG-MH-HIGH-002 (the two 'alone' medium flags are suppressed); M1-AUTH-001 fires for any declarationConfirmed !== 'yes' (so '' and 'no' both fire) and FLAG-AUTH-LOW-001 mirrors it, even on a Q1 = No form. Regenerate expected with: bin/test-personas united-kingdom-driver-and-vehicle-licensing-agency-m1-form --update

personas.name: Seven co-occurring conditions with suicidal ideation - declaration refused
personas.description: Daniel Okafor-Hughes, 29, of Manchester: Q1 yes with seven Q2 conditions ticked - anxiety/depression WITH suicidal thoughts, bipolar, eating disorder, OCD/PTSD, personality disorder, schizophrenia/psychosis and 'other' with the details box left blank. No healthcare contact in the last 12 months (Q3 no). GP name and date-last-seen blank (surgery name present). Declaration 'no', signatory name blank, signature date present. Hand-derived firedRules after the priority sort: M1-AUTH-001 (high); M1-HCP-001, M1-Q2-002, M1-AUTH-002 (medium, in rule order); M1-HCP-003 (low) - 5 rules, complete false, stoppedAtQ1 false, conditionCount 7. additionalFlags (8) after the stable sort: FLAG-MH-URGENT-001 (urgent); FLAG-MH-HIGH-001, FLAG-MH-HIGH-002, FLAG-AUTH-LOW-001 (high - note the LOW id with high priority); FLAG-MH-HIGH-003 (medium despite its HIGH id), FLAG-MH-MED-003, FLAG-CONTACT-MED-001, FLAG-MULTI-MED-001 ('7 co-occurring mental health conditions') (medium). FLAG-MH-MED-001/002 are suppressed because bipolar and personality disorder co-occur.
